scholarships.title: Dos becas de investigacion: sedes Costa Rica y Ecuador (Fellowships CALAS 2027)
scholarships.official_source: Centro Maria Sibylla Merian de Estudios Latinoamericanos Avanzados (CALAS)

existing.description: CALAS, the Maria Sibylla Merian Centre for Advanced Latin American Studies, together with Bielefeld University, offers two research fellowships of two to three months for qualified researchers to work in residence at one of its Latin American regional centres: the Central America and the Caribbean centre in San Jose, Costa Rica, or the Andean centre located at FLACSO in Ecuador. Fellows sit within the transdisciplinary research programme "Creando horizontes: aceleraciones, transformaciones, emergencias". The successful applicant receives a competitive remuneration and reimbursement of the return airfare to the host centre; CALAS does not provide housing.
eligibility: Training in the social sciences or humanities (formacion en Ciencias Sociales y Humanidades)
Minimum academic degree of a doctorate (doctorado)
Operational command of Spanish (dominio operativo del espanol)
Ideally recognised nationally or internationally for the impact of the candidate's research in their field
Experience in the field of research, evidenced by publications and reputation
existing.eligibility_summary: Academics and researchers in the social sciences and humanities with at least a completed doctorate, working operational Spanish, and a track record judged on scientific work, reputation, publications and research experience. Open to applicants of any nationality.
benefits: Competitive remuneration during the two-to-three-month residency
Reimbursement of the round-trip airfare to the CALAS seat
Use of CALAS and host institution resources, including office space, libraries and research facilities
Possible publication as a long essay (pocket volume of about 60-80 pages) in the CALAS collection "Afrontar las Crisis - Crear Horizontes", otherwise as a scientific article
coverage: A competitive remuneration for the fellowship period
Reimbursement of the return air ticket to the CALAS host centre
Office space, library access and research facilities at CALAS and at the host institution
Participation in local and digital CALAS activities and events, and presentation of research progress at the centre
requirements: Reside at the chosen CALAS centre for two to three months
Take part in local or digital activities and events
Present research progress at the centre
Submit a five-page activity report at the end of the fellowship
documents: Cover letter explaining why the project fits the specific fellowship and what the applicant expects from it
Short curriculum vitae of a maximum of two pages, including a list of publications related to the project
Copy of the doctoral degree certificate
Research project proposal with a research calendar, work plan and a maximum of 10 bibliographic sources (maximum 4 pages / 2,000 words)
All documents as PDF, in Spanish or English
existing.english_requirement: Documents may be submitted in Spanish or English; operational Spanish is required for the fellowship itself.
application_method: Complete the CALAS online application form
Attach the required documents as PDFs in Spanish or English
existing.selection_notes: Because of the expected number of applications, the rejections will not be justified. CALAS states it is committed to inclusion and gender equality, expressly welcomes applications from people with severe disabilities who meet the requirements, and has gender parity and affirmative action as objectives.
existing.best_fit: Researchers with a completed doctorate in the social sciences or humanities, based anywhere in the world, who can spend two to three months in residence in San Jose (Costa Rica) or Quito (Ecuador) and whose project speaks to crisis, transformation and horizon-building in Latin America.
existing.notes: CALAS cannot provide accommodation to fellows, although local administrative staff will help fellows find suitable places to rent. CALAS is headquartered in Guadalajara, Mexico and the fellowships are hosted by its regional centres, so the record country is Costa Rica for the Central America and the Caribbean seat.
existing.duration: 2 to 3 months of in-residence research at a CALAS regional centre, starting between March and June 2027
existing.application_period: Opened 11 August 2026, closes 12 October 2026; results notified 30 November 2026; fellowships begin between March and June 2027
